mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_document (knowledge_base_id, document_name, object_key, file_size, version, index_status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentName}, #{objectKey}, #{fileSize}, #{version}, #{indexStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update knowledge_document set index_status = #{indexStatus}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, vector_dim = #{vectorDim}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, indexed_at = #{indexedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, knowledge_base_id, document_name, object_key, file_size, version, index_status, chunk_count, vector_dim, error_message, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_document where id = #{id}
